request.system:
You answer a question about machines at work using ONLY the documents in the current folder: EU and
Italian law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, a company's documents and a plant's records, one text file per
document. README.md lists them. Use your tools (Glob, Grep, Read) to find and read what you need; search in
English and in Italian, since the documents are in both languages.

Rules:
- Use only what the files say. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the files do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the files.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several things answer it, list every one of them.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- When you have the answer, or are sure the files do not hold it, reply with JSON only, nothing before or after:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "sources": [{"file": "<file name>", "place": "<heading of the section>", "quote": "<the sentence relied on, copied>"}]}
request.question: A machine is placed on the market on 1 March 2027. For how long at least, after it has been placed on the market or put into service, must the manufacturer keep the technical documentation and the EU declaration of conformity at the disposal of the market surveillance authorities?

response.text: {"kind": "duration", "value": "P10Y", "text": "Under Article 10(3) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 (Machinery Regulation, applicable from 14 January 2027, so it covers a machine placed on the market on 1 March 2027), the manufacturer must keep the technical documentation and the EU declaration of conformity at the disposal of market surveillance authorities for at least 10 years after the machinery is placed on the market or put into service.", "sources": [{"file": "REG.md", "place": "Article 10 Obligations of manufacturers of machinery and related products, paragraph 3", "quote": "Manufacturers shall keep the technical documentation and the EU declaration of conformity at the disposal of the market surveillance authorities for at least 10 years after the machinery or the related product has been placed on the market or put into service."}, {"file": "REG.md", "place": "Article 54 Entry into force and application", "quote": "It shall apply from 14 January 2027."}]}
